design.name: 沙炮手
design.brief: The bandit faction's squat heavy artillery gunner: a short, stocky, barrel-bodied figure under a very wide conical woven bamboo hat with a sand-coloured cloth curtain hanging around the back, a dark face cloth with two glowing ember-orange eyes and brass flip-up goggles on the hat brim, a quilted sand-and-brown padded coat, a bandolier of brass shell casings across the chest, the faction's crimson waist sash with the gold spiral emblem, a big wooden-and-bronze ammunition rack backpack holding three glowing ember-orange shells upright, thick leather gloves with a separate thumb and four separate fingers, heavy wrapped boots.
design.weapon: a short heavy bronze hand mortar with a roaring dragon-mouth muzzle, carried in both hands
